messages:
mira: Heads-up — ACME asked for per-tenant autoscale knobs on Dedicated: ability to set min/max slots, burst priority, and a grace window for scaledown. They want guarantees when on reserved pools. What's realistic?
kevin (Eng - Runtime): We can expose min/max slots + a preemption_priority integer. Signals we can act on: GPU util, SM % (if CUDA), request queue depth, and 99th tail latency. Prefer a composite signal rather than single util.
sam (Eng - Infra): Two operational concerns: (1) scaledown grace — if we shrink too fast we lose KV cache and regen cost spikes; recommend 5m default with configurable override. (2) burst banking — need rate-limited token bucket per-tenant so bursts don't blow overall pool.
jana (Customer Success): ACME specifically needs: a) SLA while in reserved pool, b) visible billing for burst usage, c) easy opt-in toggles and a rollback path. They also want a beta window with their SREs.
mira: Proposed launch checklist (short): 
- perf regression < 2% P95 on representative workloads
- scaledown grace default = 5m, configurable
- per-tenant burst token bank with cap and refill rules
- telemetry: per-tenant slot history + preempt events + cost attribution
- canary rollout to top 5 tenants then opt-in self-serve
- docs + billing integration + CS-run beta
kevin (Eng - Runtime): Implementation notes: expose config fields: `min_slots`, `max_slots`, `preemption_priority`, `burst_tokens` (cap/refill/sec), `scaledown_grace_seconds`. Fallback rule: if model not compatible with warm cache, route to compatible variant (requires model mapping). Also gate by model size/seq length for kernel choices.
sam (Eng - Infra): Flag names for rollout: `runtime.tenanted_scaling_v1` and `infra.burst_bank`. Also need an ops dashboard to see pool-level spillover and top borrowers.
mira: Acceptance criteria for GA: signed-off perf tests, billing events show up in invoice sample, docs + self-serve toggle live, beta tenants on for 2 weeks with no major incidents.
opsbot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for 2024-03-25 22:00 UTC — will enable `runtime.tenanted_scaling_v1` in 10% of reserved pools.
jana: I'll coordinate ACME SRE for the 2-week beta and validate billing visibility.
mira: Great — i'll turn this into an RFC (short) and assign owners. @kevin @sam please add rough engineering estimates by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
